title: Speak Like a Presenter: Voice, Pace and Body Language
objective: Students practice delivery skills that make biology content easier to follow.
context: Slide: “Pond birds. Morning: 12. Afternoon: 5.” The slide is for first-year students.

items.prompt: Write one short sentence to say aloud. Add a slash where you will pause.
items.answer: Example: We saw twelve birds in the morning / and five in the afternoon.

items.prompt: Say your sentence at a steady pace. Point to each number as you say it.
items.answer: Listen for clear numbers and a pause. Watch for a gesture that matches each number.

items.prompt: Ask a partner to repeat the main message. Write one change you will make.
items.answer: Accept one concrete change from feedback, such as a longer pause before the second number.
